title: Record the owner's approval of BL-28
body:
One line in `docs/BACKLOG.approved.md`, recording that the owner approved **BL-28** in chat after reviewing the two-format comparison.

Its own branch because the `plan` check's uncapped exemption covers `docs/BACKLOG.md` but **not** `docs/BACKLOG.approved.md` — so a branch carrying the filing and the approval together falls back to the 50-line cap, which BL-28's filing is far over. Splitting is the fix the check itself recommends.

Depends on the filing landing first, so the id it names resolves.
